options: Copy a script to the SD card
The lua start command in MAVProxy
questions.explain: After the reboot the other SCR_ parameters appear.

questions.q: Where do scripts live on the flight controller?
options: In the root of the SD card
Inside the firmware, in the ROMFS section
questions.explain: In SITL, the scripts folder of the directory the simulator was started from.

options: Itself and a delay in ms
questions.explain: A function and the delay until the next call: the scheduler calls it again, so there are no infinite loops.

questions.q: If the Lua engine itself dies (Lua: Engine Error)…
questions.explain: All scripts stop until scripting is restarted; an error in one script, including running out of memory inside its own call, removes only that script.

questions.q: Why do scripts that use SIM_* never go onto a real vehicle?
options: A real FC has no SIM_* parameters
They are too large to fit
questions.explain: SIM_* exists only in the simulator.

questions.q: What does the update() function return in ArduPilot Lua?
options: update and a delay in ms
A boolean true/false and an error code

questions.q: What is the motor_failure_test.lua applet used for?
questions.explain: It stops motors by a bitmask (MOT_STOP_BITMASK) with an RCx_OPTION 300 switch to test a failure.
